Question 3
?
Consider the curve with parametric equations x=32t+1,y=−54t+2,−1≤t≤4. Fill in the blanks in the following table of values:
t −1 0 1 2 3 4
x
−12​
 1 52 4
112​
 7
y
134​
 2 34 −12 −74 −3
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

  • To find the value of x(−1), we substitute t=−1 into x=32t+1. This gives x(−1)=32(−1)+1=−32+22=−12.

  • To find the value of y(−1), we substitute t=−1 into y=−54t+2. This gives y(−1)=−54(−1)+2=54+84=134.

  • To find the value of x(3), we substitute t=3 into x=32t+1. This gives x(2)=32(3)+1=92+22=112.

Then the table is

t −1 0 1 2 3 4
x −12 1 52 4 112 7
y 134 2 34 −12 −74 −3
